steps.instruction: Change `list` so that todos with a `due` value appear before todos without one. Keep the sort stable: inside each group (with due date / without), keep the order the items would have had before this change. Do not sort by the due date value itself. Done-filtering and `includeDone` behaviour stay exactly as they are now. Do not mutate the input array. Treat `due` as present only when it is a non-empty string. Add unit tests for this in src/commands.test.ts.

input.reason: Listing order is decided in commands.list. A stable partition (due-dated items first) does exactly what was asked and changes no interfaces.
